english.note: Use 得到 as the all-purpose choice when someone obtains or receives something from a source.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for acquiring or receiving something.

examples.english: I derive a lot of information from this book.
examples.traditional: 我從呢本書得到好多資料。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 cung4 ni1 bun2 syu1 dak1 dou2 hou2 do1 zi1 liu2

examples.english: I finally gain possession of the prize.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou2 fan6 zoeng2 ban2
